description: This file defines an abstract Java class named Task that implements the Runnable interface. It provides a framework for creating long-running tasks that can be started, canceled, and optionally auto-restarted. The class manages thread lifecycle and supports subclassing for custom behavior with hooks like onStart, onStop, onCancel, and execute.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: An abstract class for creating cancellable, auto-restartable long-running tasks that execute in their own thread.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Returns whether the task is currently running.

methods.name: isCanceled
methods.description: Returns whether the task has been marked for cancellation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the task in a new thread if it is not already running.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Requests cancellation of the task and optionally waits for the thread to stop.

methods.name: shouldAutoRestart
methods.description: Indicates whether the task should automatically restart after stopping.

methods.name: setAutoRestart
methods.description: Sets the auto-restart behavior for the task.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main execution method of the task that performs initialization, repeated execution, cleanup, and handles auto-restart.

methods.name: keepLooping
methods.description: Evaluates whether the main loop should continue running; can be overridden for custom conditions.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Hook called at the beginning of the thread execution, before the loop.

methods.name: onRestart
methods.description: Hook called just before restarting the thread if auto-restart is enabled.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Hook called at the end of execution, after the loop stops.

methods.name: onCancel
methods.description: Hook called when the task is canceled, after setting the cancel flag.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses, defining the task's core behavior executed repeatedly.
